notes.title: FALLEN Demo Release
notes.notes:
[u][b]FALLEN's Official Demo is finally coming![/b]
[/u]
The demo will be launched during Steam's Upcoming Next Fest on the 1st of October. 

In this demo, [u]the first chapter of the finalized story[/u] will make its appearance. Alongside this, several newly added features will be showcased too.
